Serious allergic reactions can happen.","issue":"The piece omits several critical warnings required by the approved label: serious infections, tuberculosis screening, hepatic enzyme elevations, hypersensitivity reactions, malignancy risk, and immunisation precautions.","explanation":"The label requires disclosure of multiple serious risks, including the full range of infection hazards (bacterial, fungal, and viral), specific tuberculosis screening and prophylaxis guidance, monitoring of liver enzymes with specific thresholds (≥3x upper limit of normal in 2.1% vs 0.6% placebo), hypersensitivity reactions including angioedema, unknown malignancy risk, and avoidance of live vaccines. The piece's safety section addresses only generic infection risk ('lower your ability to fight infections'), mentions TB testing without the screening/prophylaxis guidance, notes 'changes in liver blood tests' without quantification or monitoring instructions, and summarises serious allergic reactions without naming the specific manifestations or discontinuation requirement. Tuberculosis. Screen for latent tuberculosis before initiating treatment and consider anti-tuberculosis therapy before starting ZELVORAN in patients with latent infection. Hepatic enzyme elevations. Elevations in ALT or AST greater than three times the upper limit of normal occurred in 2.1% of ZELVORAN-treated patients compared with 0.6% receiving placebo. Monitor liver enzymes at baseline and periodically during treatment. Hypersensitivity reactions. Serious hypersensitivity reactions, including angioedema, have been reported. Discontinue immediately if a serious reaction occurs. Malignancy. The effect of ZELVORAN on the risk of malignancy is not known. ## What Zelvoran can do

Zelvoran® (zelvoran) is indicated for the treatment of moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis in adults
who are candidates for systemic therapy or phototherapy.

In a 16-week randomised trial, 68.4% of adults treated with Zelvoran achieved PASI-75 compared with
9.2% receiving placebo [1].

Whatever your age, whatever your stage, Zelvoran may be the answer your family has been waiting for.","issue":"Multiple unqualified efficacy claims appear before the safety section, with no risk qualification adjacent to or preceding them, violating the requirement that claims be accompanied by their qualifying risk language.","explanation":"The validator found that all four efficacy claims appear before the first risk disclosure (which begins at character 533). This presentation structure violates fair balance because it allows benefit to dominate a reader's first impression without immediate qualification.","suggested_fix":"Introduce safety content earlier in the piece, ideally immediately after the indication statement, rather than relegating it to a separate section after all efficacy claims.
